ca_cert_file.description: Path to a CA cert (PEM) to verify the control-plane TLS cert. Env: `FREESWITCH_CACERT`.

insecure.description: Skip TLS verification. Env: `FREESWITCH_INSECURE`. Not for production.

block.description: Manage FreeSWITCH through the FreeSWITCH IaC control-plane API. This provider is a client for that API and requires a running control-plane (see https://github.com/jamalshahverdiev/freeswitch-iac-platform); it does not talk to FreeSWITCH directly.

status.description: Initial status on load (live status is runtime state).

block.description: A mod_callcenter agent. `contact` is usually `user/<number>@<domain>` of a freeswitch_user.

params.description: Extra queue params merged into the rendered XML.

block.description: A mod_callcenter queue (served to FreeSWITCH from the control-plane DB).
Reloads mod_callcenter (re-reads the DB-served callcenter.conf) whenever `triggers` change.
Binds a callcenter agent to a queue (with level/position).

auto_record.description: Recording path template; empty disables recording.

params.description: Extra profile params merged into the rendered XML.

video_mode.description: Empty = audio only; `mux` = composed video conference.

block.description: A mod_conference profile (settings group). Set `video_mode = "mux"` for a video conference with composed layouts. Profiles are read when a NEW conference starts — no reload needed.

context.description: Dialplan context the entry extension is rendered into.

priority.description: Dialplan ordering — keep lower than broad catch-all extensions.

block.description: A conference room: the room itself plus the dialplan extension callers dial to enter it (rendered into `/xml/dialplan` automatically).

mac.description: Device MAC (any separators; normalized to lowercase, no separators).

number.description: SIP extension; its password is taken from the matching freeswitch_user.

block.description: A provisioned physical SIP phone. The control-plane serves its config at `GET /provision/<mac>` (the SIP password is read from the matching `freeswitch_user`).

field.description: Channel variable to match (e.g. `destination_number`). Omit for a pure time gate.

time.description: FreeSWITCH time-of-day attributes, e.g. `{ wday = "2-6", hour = "9-17" }`. Supported keys: wday, mday, mon, mweek, week, hour, minute, time-of-day, date-time.

block.description: Ordered actions for this condition. At least one is required.
Ordered match conditions. At least one is required.
A FreeSWITCH dialplan extension (ordered conditions with actions).
A FreeSWITCH directory domain (tenant).
A FreeSWITCH Sofia SIP gateway / trunk.

result.description: ESL reply from the last reloadxml.

triggers.description: Arbitrary key/value pairs; any change re-runs reloadxml.

block.description: Runs FreeSWITCH `reloadxml` via the control-plane ESL whenever `triggers` change. Use `triggers` + `depends_on` to apply config after other resources change.

attach_file.description: Attach the recording to the email (vm-attach-file).

voicemail.description: Typed mod_voicemail mailbox. Rendered into the directory as vm-* params. Omit the block to leave the user without voicemail.

block.description: A FreeSWITCH SIP user / extension.
Looks up an existing mod_callcenter agent by name.
Looks up an existing mod_callcenter queue by name.
Looks up an existing mod_callcenter tier (queue/agent binding).
Looks up an existing conference profile by name.
Looks up an existing conference room by name.
Live participants of a running conference (via ESL `conference xml_list`).
Look up a provisioned phone by its MAC (any separators; normalized server-side).
Look up an existing dialplan extension by id.
Look up an existing FreeSWITCH domain by name.
Look up an existing gateway by profile and name.
Runtime status of a Sofia gateway (via ESL `sofia status gateway`).

voicemail.description: Typed voicemail mailbox (null if the user has none).

block.description: Look up an existing SIP user by domain and number.
Runtime SIP registration state for a user (via ESL `show registrations`).
Read a user's voicemail mailbox (messages + MWI counters) from freeswitch_core. Read-only.
